one_line: Veteran artillery officer of the Bareilly Brigade and de facto commander of the Delhi rebel forces in 1857.

appearance.age_look: Late 50s, solid broad-shouldered build with the presence of an experienced soldier.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, medium brown North Indian complexion, deep-set sharp eyes under thick brows, straight prominent nose, neatly trimmed full beard with streaks of grey, and a calm, stern default expression that suggests disciplined authority under pressure.
appearance.hair: Dark brown hair with grey at the temples, worn short and combed back, mostly hidden under a deep maroon woolen Rohilla-style turban wrapped high with a slightly tapered silhouette and a narrow dark green band near the base, no plume or metal decoration.
appearance.costume: He wears a long knee-length angarkha-style coat of heavy cotton in muted indigo blue, overlapping to the right and fastened with cloth ties, the edges and cuffs piped in a narrow dull-gold trim; over this, a dark brown leather waistbelt and a broader faded red cloth sash are tied firmly around his middle, with the sash knotted to one side. Under the coat, loose churidar-style trousers in off‑white cotton are slightly wrinkled and gathered at the ankles. On his feet are sturdy brown leather shoes with slightly upturned toes, practical rather than ornate. Over the angarkha he has a sleeveless quilted cotton armour vest in dusty olive green, stitched in rectangular panels, looking worn but serviceable. A simple light beige cotton shawl with a thin brown border is draped over one shoulder and across his back, hinting at both status and utility. His jewellery is minimal: a single plain silver ring on one hand and a small, modest silver earring in one ear, emphasizing his soldierly austerity rather than courtly finery.
appearance.signature: A well-used brass-mounted officer’s sword of mid-19th‑century pattern with a slightly curved steel blade and a simple knuckle-guard hilt, worn sheathed on his left side in a dark brown leather scabbard with brass fittings, his right hand often resting on the hilt as he surveys siege lines and issues orders.

ref_desc: Bakht Khan Rohilla is a late‑middle‑aged, broad‑shouldered man with a grey‑streaked beard, deep maroon Rohilla turban, indigo angarkha, quilted olive vest, off‑white churidar trousers, brown leather shoes and belt, carrying a curved brass‑mounted sword in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full‑body anime‑style character sheet of Bakht Khan Rohilla: a late‑middle‑aged, broad‑shouldered North Indian man with an oval face, thick brows, deep‑set sharp eyes, medium brown complexion, and a neatly trimmed grey‑streaked beard, wearing a tall deep maroon Rohilla‑style turban with a narrow dark green band. Show his indigo blue knee‑length angarkha coat with dull‑gold piping, belted by a dark brown leather waistbelt and a broader faded red cloth sash, over off‑white churidar trousers and sturdy brown leather shoes. Add a sleeveless quilted dusty olive green cotton armour vest over the coat and a light beige shawl with a thin brown border draped over one shoulder. Keep jewellery minimal: a plain silver ring and a small silver earring. At his left side show his brass‑mounted, slightly curved officer’s sword in a dark brown leather scabbard with simple brass fittings, his right hand resting on the hilt. Use indigo blue, deep maroon, dusty olive green, off‑white, and brown leather as dominant colours, and present him front, side, and back in a clean, consistent anime design ready for repeated panels.
